const fn file_link(
    _ page: PageBuilder<VIEW_CAPACITY>,
    _ file: String<31>,
    _ description: String<31>,
) -> PageBuilder<VIEW_CAPACITY> {
    page.open(element: PageElement::Anchor)
        .attribute(value: PageAttribute::class(value: "file"))
        .attribute(
            value: PageAttribute::href(value: PageText::three(first: "source/", second: file, third: ".view")),
        )
        .attribute(
            value: PageAttribute::action(value: InspectorAction::Source),
        )
        .open(element: PageElement::Code)
        .text(value: label(file))
        .close()
        .open(element: PageElement::Span)
        .text(value: label(description))
        .close()
        .close()
}
